AppendWithoutIdemKey.because: A paid step adds its ledger line without looking for its idempotency key, so a retry or a second job that is served from the cache adds a line for a provider call that was never made.

IdemKeyWithoutStep.because: The idempotency key does not name the step key, so the first call for a second paid step looks already charged and its cost is never recorded.

IdemKeyWithJob.because: The idempotency key names the job as well as the step key and the call, so a second job with the same inputs adds a ledger line for a step that was served from the cache.

IdemKeyWithoutCall.because: The idempotency key names the step key but not which call it was, so when a result is removed and the provider is called again, the second call looks already charged and its cost is never recorded.

CallWithoutCacheCheck.because: A paid step calls the provider without looking in the cache for its step key, so a retry or a second job with the same inputs pays the provider again while the result is still stored.

VerifyWithoutStateCheck.because: Verify accepts any job that has an output from an earlier attempt, so a job is marked verified on a stale output while its retry has not rendered.

ClaimWithoutStateCheck.because: A render claims a job without checking that it is waiting, so two renders work on the same job at once.

RecoverWithoutLockCheck.because: Recovery marks a rendering job failed without checking that its render has stopped, so the job leaves the rendering state while a render is still working on it.
